description: The contemporary design of the Lorenzi Collection is enhanced by the addition of the durable black vinyl covering that encases each piece in the collection. Painted gray hardware provides a distinct contrast to the fabric’s finish. Scaled for urban living, this collection will prove to be a unique and stylish addition to your master, youth, and guest bedrooms.
